title: Overall Vehicle Performance
summary: Reviews in this topic that express a clear opinion praise the G60's overall vehicle performance, while many other fragments mention performance without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the G60's overall performance as good, excellent, wonderful, and satisfying.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention performance or strong performance without enough context to tell whether the customer view is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The sampled evidence is heavily composed of brief, generic statements about performance, so it provides limited detail on specific attributes such as acceleration, handling, or power delivery.
Many fragments in this topic are too short to determine sentiment, which limits interpretation.
The examples are stratified samples rather than representative estimates of all reviews in the topic.
